doc.title: Tom Albert and Milton "Mooney" Martin Interview, 1964-12-21

chapter: The Rika band and funeral bands
title: Who followed whom in the Rika band: Schatz, Poissy, Wilson, Landry
summary: Martin and Tom work out the succession of players in the band: Tom took Schatz's place, Poissy followed him, and Joe got in when trumpeter Wilson died, with Landry dying after.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: That's right. In St. Glover. One Sunday I went back here. Alright.
And I had Schatz. Yeah, yeah. He was in there. Schatz, Wilson, and another fellow.
Yeah, he died. Yeah, he took a corner, he died. I forget his name. Him.
Alright, now you come in behind Schatz. You took Schatz's place that day. Yeah, I did. Yeah, I did took Schatz's place. Schatz's place. And you played there till you quit.
Who took your place? Oh, this boy here. Poissy. Oh, Poissy. Poissy was the extra man. Yeah, but the... Poissy. Yeah, Poissy was the extra man, but I took Poissy's place. No, no.
You took Schatz's place. Yeah. Schatz. Uh-huh. Then Poissy come behind you. When you stopped, Poissy got in there.
Yeah, that's right. Poissy got in there.
I remember T-Boy Ramey was there when I first heard him. T-Boy, you remember? Yeah. And T-Boy? Yeah.

Willie Paggio. Used to play the trumpet? Well, yeah, them were the late ones. Those were late, late, late. I remember T-Boy too. If you took Wilson there died then, that's who...that's how Joe got in there when Wilson died. Oh, yeah. When Landry died after Wilson.
